abilities.description: Expert at rigging and riding improvised cable crossings in shifting gravity and vacuum exposure.
abilities.name: Cable Rigging

abilities.description: Rapid assessment of structural and decompression hazards along the spine.
abilities.name: Hull Triage

abilities.description: Reputation for neutrality lets her carry messages that no one else could.
abilities.name: Trusted Courier

characters.arc: Isolde moves from rigid neutrality to active mediation, accepting the personal risk of vouching for a compromise and becoming the voice that turns the standoff toward negotiation.
characters.description: A forty-year-old senior Tether Warden born in Cinder Ring, Isolde has spent twenty years riding the cable crossings. She is lean and wiry, with a rope-scarred left hand and a cold-bleached braid. She was among the first responders at the Spine Collapse memorial drills and carries her mentor's cracked rigging gauge. Since the Verdancy Declaration she is the only person both governments still trust to move people across the Severed Spine.
characters.external_conflict: Both governments pressure her to close or open the crossings, and half her guild wants to side with Ring Seven.
characters.flaw: She trusts procedure over people and hides her fear behind rigid, unyielding protocol.
characters.goal: Keep a neutral crossing open long enough to broker a face-to-face meeting between the Helm Council and the Verdant Assembly.
characters.internal_conflict: She believes neutrality is the Wardens' creed, but she increasingly suspects that refusing to choose lets people die.
characters.motivation: To make sure no one else dies on a cable because of a political fight, as her mentor did in the Hollow Sixteen drills.
characters.name: Isolde Vance

abilities.description: Deep knowledge of the founding charter and its emergency powers.
abilities.name: Charter Law

abilities.description: Commands Council security forces with unquestioned authority.
abilities.name: Command Presence

characters.arc: Marek hardens as the crisis deepens, nearly orders an assault, and is finally confronted with the structural cost of his certainty, forcing him to yield or fall.
characters.description: A hereditary Helm Council marshal in his fifties, Marek is tall and immaculate, with a grey uniform he has never been seen to wrinkle. He grew up in the Charter Chamber archives and sees the charter as the ship's skeleton. He lost a brother in the Lean Winter rationing riots and believes weak governance caused it.
characters.external_conflict: Moderate Council members and the Verdant Assembly both resist his push to escalate.
characters.flaw: He cannot tolerate dissent and treats compromise as moral weakness.
characters.goal: Restore the spine elevators under Council control, by force with stun lances if negotiation fails.
characters.internal_conflict: He knows force could rupture the structure he is sworn to protect, yet he fears that leniency will invite more secessions.
characters.motivation: To preserve the charter and the ship's unity so that the Lean Winter's chaos is never repeated.
characters.name: Marek Oduya

abilities.description: Understands the ship's air, water, and nutrient cycles well enough to adjust them precisely.
abilities.name: Closed-Loop Management

abilities.description: Rallies crowds and negotiates under pressure.
abilities.name: Public Persuasion

characters.arc: Tamsin learns that leverage without limits becomes tyranny, and she risks her leadership to ease the blockade in exchange for genuine recognition.
characters.description: The young, charismatic elected speaker of the Verdant Assembly, Tamsin is thirty-two, sun-browned from the terraces, with ink-stained fingers from the Assembly ledgers. She grew up in the reclamation vats and lost her family's allotment during the Lean Winter's lingering shortages.
characters.external_conflict: Hardliners in her Assembly want to escalate the blockade, while Marek demands surrender.
characters.flaw: She is idealistic and underestimates how far her own hardliners will go.
characters.goal: Secure a renegotiated charter that recognizes Ring Seven as sovereign without starving the other rings.
characters.internal_conflict: She uses food and water as leverage while knowing it harms innocents she wants to protect.
characters.motivation: To win recognition and fair shares for Ring Seven so its children are never rationed as punishment again.
characters.name: Tamsin Orlo

abilities.description: Can safely operate or sabotage reactor and foundry systems.
abilities.name: Reactor Tending

abilities.description: Mobilizes thousands of workers behind a single decision.
abilities.name: Labor Organizing

characters.arc: Devrin moves from hedging to a decisive stand, and his choice tips the standoff toward negotiation.
characters.description: A broad-shouldered foundry steward and the Cinder Union's chief organizer, Devrin is in his late forties, with burn-scarred forearms and a gravelly voice. He is a reactor tender by trade and was raised by parents who survived the Lean Winter.
characters.external_conflict: The Council threatens ledger penalties on Cinder Ring while Ring Seven courts him with promises he cannot verify.
characters.flaw: He is distrustful and bargains by bluffing, which makes allies doubt his word.
characters.goal: Decide whether to strike or ally with Ring Seven in a way that extracts permanent concessions for the Union.
characters.internal_conflict: He feels loyalty to the Helm Council's charter but resents what it has cost his people.
characters.motivation: To get his exhausted workers better air-ledger allotments and dignity after generations of unequal rationing.
characters.name: Devrin Kask

abilities.description: Reads stress and fatigue in cables and hull plating by sight and sound.
abilities.name: Structural Diagnostics

characters.arc: Ilse is forced to choose between her family and her conscience, and she ultimately helps Isolde at great personal cost, earning her place.
characters.description: A quiet hull technician in her twenties and Isolde's apprentice, Ilse was born in Helm Ring and is bound to it by charter. She is small and observant, with a habit of sketching cable tension diagrams on her glove.
characters.external_conflict: Marek's aides pressure her to report on Warden movements because her family still lives in Helm Ring.
characters.flaw: She is secretive and acts on her own judgment without telling her superiors.
characters.goal: Qualify as a full Warden and secure a transfer approved by neither government.
characters.internal_conflict: She is torn between loyalty to her mentor's neutrality and secret sympathy for Ring Seven's rejection of the ring-of-birth rule.
characters.motivation: To prove her worth as a Warden and escape the ring of birth that was chosen for her.
characters.name: Ilse Brandt

relationships.description: Isolde Vance trains Ilse Brandt as her apprentice Warden, but her strict protocols clash with Ilse's secret sympathies.
Marek Oduya demands that Isolde Vance close or open the crossings at his order, and he threatens the Wardens when she refuses.
Tamsin Orlo and Marek Oduya are the political poles of the standoff, each seeing the other as the cause of the crisis.
Devrin Kask considers an uneasy alliance with Tamsin Orlo, but he distrusts her promises and bargains for guarantees.
Marek Oduya uses Ilse Brandt's family in Helm Ring as leverage to make her spy on the Tether Wardens.
Isolde Vance ferries Tamsin Orlo's messages across the Severed Spine and slowly becomes her unofficial negotiating partner.
